heading: Monday, June 16, 2025
topLine: MiniMax releases open-weight MiniMax-M1 reasoning model.

items.headline: MiniMax releases open-weight MiniMax-M1 reasoning model
items.summary: MiniMax-M1 is an open-weight hybrid-attention reasoning model with 456B total and 45.9B active parameters and native 1M-token context, released in 40K and 80K thinking-budget versions. MiniMax reports it uses about 25% of DeepSeek R1's FLOPs at 100K-token generation length and was trained with a new RL algorithm, CISPO.
